title: Breakfast in Turkey
instructions: Elif Türk kahvaltısını anlatıyor. Yiyecek ve içeceklere dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In Turkey, breakfast is very big.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We eat bread, cheese, olives, tomatoes and eggs.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We drink black tea in small glasses.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Sundays, my family has breakfast together for two hours!

questions.prompt: What do they drink at breakfast?
questions.evidence: We drink black tea in small glasses.

questions.prompt: When does the family have a long breakfast?
questions.feedback: Pazar günleri iki saat birlikte kahvaltı yapıyorlar.
questions.evidence: On Sundays, my family has breakfast together
